name: Spot the Pokémon Ancestor
hook: Find a statue or picture of a Japanese creature: fox, raccoon-dog, water-child, crow-goblin or ogre.
reveal: Japan collected strange beings long before games. Pokémon borrowed a habit of cataloguing, not a one-to-one family tree.

name: Omikuji
hook: If you draw a fortune slip, read it. If it is bad luck, look how people tie them.

name: Deer Rules
hook: Read the park rules. Wild animals. No teasing. Shika senbei only. Show empty hands when you are done.
